question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start,
        lt.state
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
legislator_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        ft.first_term_start,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 0) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_0,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 2) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_2,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 4) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_4,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 6) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_6,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 8) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_8,
        TRY_CAST((DATE_PART('year', ft.first_term_start) + 10) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as checkpoint_10
    FROM first_terms ft
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        lr.id_bioguide,
        lr.gender,
        lr.state,
        lr.checkpoint_0,
        lr.checkpoint_2,
        lr.checkpoint_4,
        lr.checkpoint_6,
        lr.checkpoint_8,
        lr.checkpoint_10,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_0
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_0,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_2
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_2
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_2,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_4
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_4
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_4,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_6
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_6
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_6,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_8
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_8
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_8,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lr.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= lr.checkpoint_10
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= lr.checkpoint_10
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_10
    FROM legislator_retention lr
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        AVG(retained_0) as avg_ret_0,
        AVG(retained_2) as avg_ret_2,
        AVG(retained_4) as avg_ret_4,
        AVG(retained_6) as avg_ret_6,
        AVG(retained_8) as avg_ret_8,
        AVG(retained_10) as avg_ret_10
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
states_both AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING 
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_0 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_2 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_4 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_6 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_8 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN avg_ret_10 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_0 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_2 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_4 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_6 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_8 END) > 0 AND
        MIN(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN avg_ret_10 END) > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM states_both
ORDER BY state
